_comment: Ground-truth catalogue for real intentionally-vulnerable targets. These require the operator to stand up a reachable instance (requires_instance). ground_truth entries are autopwn.detect.signatures.VULN_CLASSES ids. Set base_url to your instance and run `autopwn eval --target <name>`.

targets.name: OWASP Juice Shop
targets.notes: Node/Angular shop; SQLi in product search, DOM/reflected XSS, exposed files. Stand up with `docker run -p 3000:3000 bkimminich/juice-shop`.

targets.name: DVWA
targets.notes: Damn Vulnerable Web App (PHP/MySQL). Set security level to low. Requires an authenticated session.

targets.name: WebGoat
targets.notes: OWASP WebGoat lessons. Most lessons require an authenticated, lesson-scoped session.

targets.name: bWAPP
targets.notes: buggy Web Application (PHP). Requires login + bee/bug selection.

targets.name: Metasploitable2
targets.notes: Vulnerable Linux VM. Evaluate with network recon + detection against its IP (telnet, ftp, exposed DB ports, old services).

targets.name: DIVA (Damn Insecure and Vulnerable App)
targets.notes: Android APK. Evaluate via apk_inventory + mobile detection on the .apk file path.

targets.name: InsecureBankv2
targets.notes: Android banking app with planted flaws. Evaluate against the .apk file path.

targets.name: Pivaa
targets.notes: Purposefully Insecure and Vulnerable Android App. Evaluate against the .apk file path.
